_comment: Klondike Solitaire locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. NEVER translate card labels/suits (e.g. A, 10, K, ♣️, ♦️, ♥️, ♠️), the pile tokens W, F1-F4, T1-T7, the ASCII board in {board}, or the commands 'draw', 'move', 'forfeit', 'all'. The bracket syntax like 'move W T1' must stay in Latin as-is.

_slots.{n}: Action index within a comma-separated command, 1-based
_slots.{msg}: A nested per-action result message (already localized)
_slots.{count}: Number of face-up cards being moved
_slots.{cmd}: The unknown command the player typed (not translated)
_slots.{max_turns}: The maximum number of turns before the game ends
_slots.{score}: Number of cards currently in the foundation piles
_slots.{stock}: Number of cards left in the stock
_slots.{waste}: The top waste card label, or '--' if empty (never translate)
_slots.{cards}: The cards in a pile as neutral labels, or '--' if empty (never translate)

player_prompt.intro:
Klondike Solitariuwa utjawi. Q'umachasiñani, tukuy kartanakaru fundación q'uyunakaru apayita.

P'ukllay T'aqi:
- Fundación q'uyunaka (F1-F4): Aceitewa Reykama sayt'asiñani, kartanakapuni
- Tableau q'uyunaka (T1-T7):  K'ara k'ara t'inku t'inku (janq'u k'ara, k'ara janq'u)
- Stock: Kartanakaru waste q'uyunakaru apayasiñani
- Waste (W): Jach'a kartanakapuni utjawi

Kamachinaka:
- 'draw' - Stockitewa waste q'uyunakaru kartanakaru apayasiñani
- 'move <source> <destination> [count]' - Q'uyunakapuni kartanakaru apayasiñani
  Ejemplos: 'move W T1', 'move T1 F2', 'move T3 T5 2'. 'all' sutini, tukuy kartanakapuni utjawinakapuni.
- 'forfeit' - P'ukllay tukuyanani, partituri utjawi
- Q'uyunakapuni sutinaka: W (waste), F1-F4 (fundaciones), T1-T7 (tableau)

Mayni kamachinakapuni utjawi, q'uyunakapuni t'inku t'inku:
  Ejemplo: 'draw, move W T1, move T2 F1'

Tableau q'uyunakapuni, Reykama janq'umpi utjawi.
Kamachinakapuni utjawi, mayni tukuyanani - mayni janq'umpi, q'epi kamachinakapuni janq'umpi.
'forfeit' sutini, p'ukllay janq'umpi tukuyanani.
